title: Completion after fixing a free coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction on $n$ coordinates, let $i$ be a coordinate that is free in $\rho$, let $s$ be a sign, and let $x$ be a binary vector of length $n$. Completing the restriction obtained by fixing $i$ to $s$, using $x$, gives the same sign vector as completing $\rho$ after replacing the $i$th entry of $x$ by the binary value corresponding to $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a binary vector of length $n$
